about.metaDescription: How ColumnaLATAM sources spine surgery conference data and verifies surgeon profiles in Latin America.
about.intro: ColumnaLATAM is an independent editorial directory of spine surgery conferences and verified spine surgeons in Latin America. We built it because information about spine events and specialists in the region is scattered across dozens of society sites, hospital pages and social media — we bring it together in one reliable place.
about.methodologyP1: Every congress, conference, course, workshop or webinar listed here comes from a real, public source — a society's official page, a hospital or university's continuing medical education calendar, an event organizer's own site, or an open public RSS feed/API. We never invent events, dates, organizers or URLs.
about.methodologyP2: Every event page lists its data source(s) and a “last verified” date. When a source only publishes a month/year, or states an event is annual with dates not yet announced, we say so explicitly (via a date note) instead of inventing a specific day.
about.methodologyP3: The event submission process is deliberately simple and auditable: administrators add and periodically re-verify events through the admin panel, and every event links to at least one source you can check yourself. We don't scrape sites that prohibit it, bypass access controls, or generate abusive request volumes against any source.
about.directoryP1: Surgeons create their own account and submit their profile. A profile is never publicly visible until an administrator reviews and approves it — draft or submitted profiles are only visible to their owner and to administrators.
about.directoryP2: We never invent surgeon identities, titles, license numbers, contact details, or photos. Any sample profile used to illustrate the directory before real submissions are onboarded is clearly labeled “Sample profile” everywhere it appears, including on its own page.
about.directoryP3: A “verified” badge means the profile passed our review process for completeness and internal consistency — it does not replace independently confirming a surgeon's license and credentials with their local medical board or institution before making any care decision.
about.securityP1: Authentication, password storage, and session handling are delegated entirely to Supabase Auth — we never see or store plaintext passwords. Every table is protected by Row Level Security, so regardless of application bugs, the database itself enforces who can read or write each row.
about.securityP2: Sensitive administrative actions (approving, rejecting, suspending or deleting a profile; creating or editing events) are logged to a write-only audit trail that no role — not even administrators — can edit or delete from the application.
about.correctionsBody: Found an error in an event or a surgeon profile? Sign in and use your dashboard to request changes to your own profile, or contact us via the published contact details on the relevant event's official site so we can correct the information.

privacy.metaDescription: ColumnaLATAM's privacy practices and medical disclaimer.
privacy.emergencyTitle: This is not an emergency medical service.
privacy.emergencyBody: If you're experiencing a medical emergency, contact your local emergency services immediately. Do not use this site to seek urgent or emergency care.
privacy.medicalP1: ColumnaLATAM is an informational directory only. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, and a surgeon's inclusion in the listing does not constitute an endorsement or guarantee of their qualifications, availability or suitability for any particular case. Conference and event information is offered for discovery purposes and may change without notice — always confirm dates, format and registration details directly with the event organizer before making travel or attendance plans.
privacy.medicalP2: Always independently verify a surgeon's license, credentials and current standing with the relevant medical board or institution, and consult directly with a qualified healthcare professional before making any decision about your care.
privacy.dataAccountBody: your email, username and full name, managed by Supabase Auth, used to authenticate you and let you manage your own submissions.
privacy.dataProfileBody: the information you choose to submit (biography, affiliations, languages, contact links and an optional photo). This stays private (draft/submitted) until an administrator approves it for public display.
privacy.dataTechBody: IP address and timestamps used only for abuse protection (rate-limiting sign-up, sign-in and form submissions), never sold or shared with third parties.
privacy.protectBody: Passwords are managed entirely by Supabase Auth and are never stored in plaintext or seen by our application code. Database access is governed by Row Level Security policies, so your draft or submitted profile cannot be read by other users, and only administrators can review it before approval. You can request deletion of your account and profile at any time from your dashboard, or by contacting an administrator.
privacy.choicesBody: You control what appears on your public surgeon profile before submitting it for review, and can edit it again if it returns to draft status. You can withdraw your profile from the directory at any time by contacting an administrator.
